text.p: - An unknown attacker on Monday threw a hand granade into the offices of Republican Union, a Slovenian rightwing political party, causing damage but injuring no one, police said.
- The average candidate at general elections to be held on Sunday is 46 years old and highly educated. Around 18 percent of candidates are female.
- Over 60 films will be presented at the seventh film festival, Film Art Fest that starts in Ljubljana on Tuesday.
- Losses of the national radio and television station are expected to reach around 1.1 billion tolars ($8.1 million) by the end of the year.
- Slovenia will invest 18.5 billion tolars ($135.3 million) to build two electrical power stations at the northwestern Soca river. Construction is expected to take four years.
- The Slovenian government will decide by November 16 whether it will increase prices of electricity by 13.4 percent or not.
- Slovenia's only port, Koper, had the highest cargo turnover in October at 822,000 tonnes, 22 tonnes more than the previous record.
- The 10th exhibition of books "Frankfurt after Frankfurt" will start in Ljubljana on Tuesday. More than 8,000 books will be exhibited there.
